component.name: VOCO
component.summary: Turn speech into text at your cursor with local dictation

description.p: Your voice, typed. Built for Linux. VOCO turns speech into text at your cursor. Press a hotkey, speak, and press it again to finish. Normal dictation is transcribed on your device and needs no account or subscription.
VOCO stays in the tray, with a compact panel for microphone feedback and dictation status. Text insertion depends on your desktop session and the target field.

ul.li: Setup for your microphone, hotkey, and Linux text insertion options
GitHub Release update checks for manual install channels
Linux-specific install, upgrade, and troubleshooting guidance

description.p: Live onboarding speech test, cancellable microphone setup and verified cursor feedback.
Test live local speech during onboarding and check for an editable cursor before dictation.
Safer capture admission, offline recovery, and public evaluation tools.
Guard incomplete capture and recover dictation with the bundled local model.
Candidate source for the next VOCO cut. Local dictation, tray-first UI and streaming cursor delivery are unchanged. Public download remains 2026.0.39 until this version is qualified and published.
Adds persistent VOCO Dictation input-source support with revisable live preedit, authoritative local checkpoints, exact-prefix delivery, and recoverable fail-closed final transcripts.
Unifies tray and settings state, adds safe configuration recovery and single-instance ownership, and hardens model-cache integrity, installers, private IPC, and release verification.
Adds bounded 10-minute dictation, chunked local transcription, append-only live cursor previews, and safer final transcript reconciliation.
Simplifies settings to direct cursor dictation, removes assistant modes, and improves settings-window dragging.
